The analysis implementation of this app references the following public technical documents and community resources. We thank them and state the sources:

1. Android APK packaging structure (ZIP / AXML / DEX)
 References AOSP and official Android documentation on ZIP structure, Android Binary XML and DEX bytecode
 - Source: https://developer.android.com/guide/components
 - Used to unpack and read classes*.dex, AndroidManifest, res/layout, assets and other entries

2. Dart AOT snapshot parsing (Flutter libapp.so)
 References Dart VM source snapshot.h and community Flutter reverse engineering resources
 - snapshot.h source: https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/blob/main/runtime/vm/snapshot.h
 - Used to locate the Dart snapshot inside libapp.so and scan for ad string features

3. Ad feature rule compilation
 Ad SDK package / domain / class / permission keywords reference the open source project DTL-X rules, expanded and organized
 - Homepage: https://github.com/Gameye98/DTL-X
 - References its adloader / domain blacklist / method keyword approach, combined with mainstream ad SDKs

4. Aho-Corasick multi-pattern matching algorithm
 Used to match thousands of ad features in a single pass over file byte streams, significantly speeding up analysis
 - Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aho–Corasick_algorithm

5. UI theme and layout
 Written based on Material Design guidelines and Material Components component library examples
 - Guidelines: https://m3.material.io/
 - Components: https://github.com/material-components/material-components-android

The above content is for technical learning reference only; the final implementation is entirely self-developed by this project. Copyright belongs to the original authors and their organizations.

This app follows the principle of minimal data collection and attaches great importance to protecting your privacy:

1. Local offline processing: All APK ad feature analysis is done locally on your device. The app never uploads any APK files or internal data to any server.

2. Transparent network behavior: The app only connects to the network when you actively tap "Check for updates" to request version information. It never connects in the background, nor collects or uploads any personal information.

3. Minimal permissions: The app does not read, store, or access your contacts, gallery, location, SMS, call history, or other sensitive information.

4. Local data storage: The app's feature configuration and analysis results are stored only on your device and are cleared when the app is uninstalled. No cloud records are kept.

5. Third-party links: The About and Update pages may contain external links. Tapping them lets third-party platforms handle your access behavior. We recommend reviewing the relevant third-party privacy policies.

6. If you have any privacy questions, suggestions, or concerns while using the app, feel free to contact us through the author's contact information. We will do our best to answer.

Please read the following disclaimer carefully before using this app:

1. Legal use restriction: This app is for learning, research, and personal lawful use only. Please analyze only apps you own, are authorized for, or have the right to analyze.

2. Results for reference only: The analyzed ad features are for technical research and reference only and do not constitute any technical conclusion or warranty. Ad SDK attribution may change with versions; please combine with the actual functionality of the APK and manual review.

3. Analysis scope limitation: This app only detects preset feature rules. An ad SDK that is not matched does not mean no ads exist, and results may contain omissions or false positives.

4. No warranty: This app is provided "as is" without any express or implied warranty. The author is not liable for any direct or indirect loss caused by using or being unable to use this app.

5. Third-party content: The open source projects and ad feature rules referenced by this app come from public channels and are for technical reference only; their copyright belongs to the original authors.

6. Term changes: The author reserves the right to modify this disclaimer at any time. Updated content will take effect in new versions.

7. Using this app means you have read, understood, and agreed to all the above terms. If you do not agree, please stop using this app.
